name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height strip at the top risks users missing the playback mark when they’re already focused on content below—orientation fails when they scroll. Better: a thin, persistent line *inside* the main view, tied to the scroll position, so it’s always in frame. Settle it by testing whether users reorient faster with the strip or the inline mark after a jump.
